scope: Direct configured verbs in one-shot, piped, and interactive modes; shared invocation engine, generated routes/help/tree/completion, exact output, process status, and optional persistent state.
authority: Local executor measurements; no deployment, independent review, new agent trial, or comparative agent-savings claim.

implementation.execution: Qualified context-id/word lowered to the existing composition invocation handler; one receipt publication and no navigation mutation.
implementation.persistence: Existing checkpoint storage, fresh temporary directory by default, optional persistent composition checkpoint; - resumes without source.
implementation.argument_policy: Ordered required string, number, and boolean scalars, with exact OS argv preservation and existing interactive quoted-token grammar.
implementation.stdout: Exact invocation JSON text plus newline, or explicit generated views; structured response envelopes with --json.
implementation.stderr: Mock labels and errors; transport failure after publication remains a transport stop.

checks.scope: Static project-record checks; no application requests executed

toolchain.dependency_change: No Cargo manifest or lockfile changes; terminal acceptance uses the host script utility.

source_identity.scope: Application source/tests, continuation tools, root Cargo files, operation declarations, run contract/task and authored connected fixture inputs.

retained_failures.result: Test compiled; the prior launcher rejected run.
Conditional directory creation expression did not bind its Result.
Read requests incorrectly carried expected_revision; initial terminal driver sent keys during cursor queries.
Tab opened the menu; the driver omitted the Enter needed to accept its selection.
The full interaction succeeded but the driver killed the wrapper during its process-exit race.

limits: Current scalar signature only: no optional/named parameters or automatic API mapping.
No additional providers; the connected capability remains the existing local JSON reader.
Historical observations do not measure service health or establish current source state.
Temporary default state is removed on normal exit; forced termination can leave its directory.
Persistent composition checkpoints require compatible declaration bytes; older binary/declaration pairs are preserved rather than migrated.
Repeating a shell command is a fresh invocation; exact latest-request replay remains a canonical protocol feature.
Failure to deliver a response can follow durable execution; inspect a persistent receipt before retrying.
No comparative agent-effort measurement or claim to cover every possible CLI.
